verdict.rationale: Zamzar's API documents format conversion across hundreds of formats, explicitly including videos and audio, so basic audio/video format-to-format transcoding is its own capability. Nothing in the evidence shows user control over codec, bitrate, or resolution, which is the power-user core of this story. The flow is simply choosing a target format, and 'Custom Conversions' on the top pricing tier is unexplained. Missing for 10: documented codec selection, bitrate control, resolution/scaling parameters, and any hands-on corroboration of audio/video transcode quality.
